name: image_adjudication_cx_agent
functionality: Compares Catalog Image (studio quality) against Customer Wild Images to determine product match, damage, and missing items. Multi-phase analysis: Phase 1 (Can't Say Firewall - bike seats, worn items, non-commerce, opaque packaging), Phase 2 (Misshipment via 5 Identity Pillars), Phase 3 (Damage - Major/Minor), Phase 4 (Missing - Major/Minor), Phase 5 (No Issue). Uses aggregation logic across multiple wild images with Evidence Override and Cumulative rules.
inputs: cx_images (customer wild images), PnP image links, product_image (catalog), return_reason, return_sub_reason, vertical
promptDescription: 4 prompt versions available. FK_PROMPT_1 (v3.0, Author: raghavendra.b, Updated: 2026-02-04): 5-Phase analysis - Phase 1: Can't Say Firewall (vehicle parts, worn items, non-commerce, opaque packaging), Phase 2: Misshipment Analysis (5 Pillars: Category/Form, Brand/Logo, Material/Pattern, Color DNA, Electronics Physical Specs), Phase 3: Damage (Major: sole separation/torn fabric/broken tubes; Minor: scratches/stains), Phase 4: Missing (Major: primary unit absent; Minor: accessories absent), Phase 5: No Issue. FK_PROMPT_2: High Precision Forensic Mode with 5-Cluster asymmetric audit and zero-tolerance misshipment. FK_PROMPT_3: Universal verifier with multi-image 3D synthesis. FK_PROMPT_4: Universal verifier with Color Family protocol and operational state exceptions. Each has 5+ few-shot examples.
